content: At GitLab LTD (UK), you are entitled to 28 days total (20 annual leave + 8 public holidays) which accrues from your start date [1]. At GitLab France S.A.S., you receive statutory vacation days per French requirements plus additional RTT days, which are tracked separately from standard PTO [2]. In both entities, you must track your time in Workday, though France requires specific categorization for RTT [1][2].

You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Annual Leave]
Time to recharge and refresh.

Leave Entitlement

- 28 days total (20 days annual leave + 8 public holidays) as per the [statutory requirements](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/)
- Accrues from start date
- Pro-rated for part-time team members

How to Report

- Select "Paid Time Off" in Workday for vacation days

[2] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Paid Time Off (Vacation)]
GitLab France provides generous paid time off in accordance with French statutory requirements, plus additional RTT (Reduction of Working Time) days. This comprehensive approach ensures you have time to rest, recharge, and maintain work-life balance.

Eligibility Requirements

All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
Entitlement based on French labor law
Must track time in Workday

Key Features

- Statutory vacation days per French requirements
- Additional RTT days for work-life balance. Team members are responsible for ensuring that they are tracking their time accurately in Workday.
- Flexible time off through [GitLab's PTO policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto)
- Team members can review [statutory requirements](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/payroll/timekeeping/france/) in relation to vacation (internal access only)
- Team members should be aware of their applicable leave categories and can [review logging requirements](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/payroll/timekeeping/france/#logging-time-away) for logging time away from work and the suggested order for using leave balances (internal access only)

How to Request Time Off

- Submit request in Workday via Slack by following these [time-off logging instructions](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/payroll/timekeeping/france/#logging-time-away-and-working-time)

Important Details

- RTT tracked separately from standard PTO

[3] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Sick Leave]
Support when you're unwell.

Leave Entitlement

Effective 6 April 2026, two significant changes apply to Statutory Sick Pay eligibility and payment.

- All team members are eligible for SSP from their first day of employment. The previous Lower Earnings Limit (requiring team members to earn at least GBP 125 per week to qualify) is abolished.
- Statutory Sick Pay for up to 28 weeks
- Runs concurrently with [GitLab Sick Time](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

How to Report

- 4-7 days absence: Complete [self-certification form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cy-xUgWwNKroUEEJ0ut80HGVA0d3RJV5mQO-amLjoCs/edit?usp=sharing)
- 7+ days absence: Provide fit note to leaves@gitlab.com
- Select "Out Sick" in Workday

[4] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
- GitLab France S.A.S. team members can review [statutory requirements for paid time off in relation to vacation](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/).
- GitLab France S.A.S. team members should be aware of their applicable leave categories and can review [the requirements for logging time away from work and the suggested order for using leave balances](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/payroll/timekeeping/france/#logging-time-away). (*_internally accessible only_)
- Team members must always submit and carefully categorise their leave via Workday, which can be accessed via Okta, mobile and Slack.
For any support or inquiries relating to Workday absence management or leave balances please open a [Compass ticket](https://app.serval.com/new-request) with the People Operations team, who will support or direct the query as needed.
- GitLab team members are also entitled to [RTT time](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/) and we recognise this is different from PTO. Team members are responsible for ensuring that they are tracking and categorising their time accurately in Workday. When entering RTT time, team members should select the RTT time off category in Workday.

**To elect beneficiaries**:

[5] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Statutory Sick Leave**]
Comprehensive sick leave coverage that builds over time, supporting you during illness while running alongside GitLab's additional sick time support.

Leave Entitlement & Key Details

**Sick Leave Entitlement:**

- **Eligibility:** 10 days statutory sick leave after 6 months continuous employment
- **Annual entitlement:** 10 days per 12-month period after meeting initial criteria
- **Carry over:** If in any year the team member doesn't meet the criteria, then they don't get any new sick leave entitlement, but can use their sick leave balance which may have carried over. An employee may re-qualify for sick leave as soon as they meet the criteria.
- **Maximum accumulation:** 20 days under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003
- **Additional Support:** Runs concurrently with [GitLab's Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

**How to Apply:**

1. Contact leaves@gitlab.com when taking sick leave
2. Medical certificate may be required per Holidays Act
3. Select "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking
4. Unused sick leave is not paid out upon employment termination
